introHtml: Jersey dress shirts combine the polished look of a dress shirt with the comfortable stretch and softness of jersey knit fabric. Ideal for companies that want a professional appearance without the stiffness of traditional woven shirts, these shirts resist wrinkles and move with the wearer. Perfect for trade show teams or daily office wear, they accept screen printing and embroidery cleanly. Order custom jersey dress shirts in bulk to outfit your team with durable, all-day comfort.
